profile.headline: DevOps @ Scale AI
profile.summary: Joji is a software engineer with experience delivering automated solutions that support DevOps best practices. Thrives in collaborate environments building lasting and quality solution for customer obstacles. His areas of expertise include Continuous Integration, Continuous Deployment, Configuration Management, Containers, Serverless and Cloud Migration.

positions.title: DevOps Consultant
positions.description: Serving as a consultant in the Professional Services organization, with a focus on delivering DevOps solutions for Global Financial Services customers. Additional supported CodeStar service.

positions.title: Lead Technologist
positions.description:
National Science Foundation(NSF) - DevOps Tech Lead
•	Created tool integrations using bash, groovy, and python to connect Jenkins, Jira, SVN, and Nexus
•	Managed server and Jenkins configurations using Ansible/Chef
•	Managed administrations of DevOps tools and multiple SCM repositories.
•	Configured and designed the CI/CD pipelines for NSF applications
•	Achieved continuous delivery of microservices using Jenkins pipelines
•	Managed and Configured App Dynamics agents for continuous monitoring 
•	Managed a team of DevOps and Configuration management engineers supporting SDLC at NSF
•	Facilitated quarterly planning, scrums, retrospectives and other Agile ceremonies
